what: The three cohorts of the hyperscaler and neocloud build-out monitor (blueprint section 15.0). Ticker, CIK and name as in company-index.js; fiscal year end as data.sec.gov/submissions reports it, verified 2026-09-11; the quirks the panel builder must know per filer. Hand-edited; the weekly refresh reads coverage.js, not this file.
verifiedAgainst: https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json (name, fiscalYearEnd, sic, formerNames, filings.recent), read through scripts/lib/sec-pull.mjs fetchSubmissions
landlordsDefaultWhy: decision 12.16 (2026-09-11): Equinix and Digital Realty sit behind the cohort toggle, off by default
neocloudLabelWhy: decision 12.18 (2026-09-11): the SIC override label for the six neoclouds, applied by CIK in scripts/lib/sic-map.mjs INDUSTRY_OVERRIDES
quarterGrid: keyed by period-end date, never by fiscal year and period: a column is the calendar quarter containing the period end. MSFT and IREN quarters end Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec and align without adjustment (the fiscal label shows on hover); ORCL and APLD quarters end Feb/May/Aug/Nov, sit in the calendar quarter of their period end, and every aggregate that includes them carries the footnote 'Oracle and Applied Digital quarters end one month before the calendar quarter'.
signConvention: outflows (capex, buybacks, dividends, repayments) stored positive; proceeds positive; a line transcribed from a 'Less:' reconciliation keeps the cash-flow sign
historyStart: A per-filer first period end (historyStart) where the CIK predates the company: scripts/build-strategy-panel.mjs cuts the companyfacts document to facts ending on or after it (trimHistory in scripts/lib/statements.mjs) before it builds the panel row, so the shell or predecessor years never reach the panel. The live panel route (api/panel.js) does not read this file; the six neoclouds are in the static panel, so that path is not reached for them.

hyperscalers.name: MICROSOFT CORP
notes: June 30 fiscal year: FQ1 = calendar Q3, FQ2 = Q4, FQ3 = Q1, FQ4 = Q2; companyfacts fy=2026 fp=FY is the year to 2026-06-30. Hover label 'FQ4 FY26 = Apr-Jun 2026'.
Three-month cash-flow facts are tagged for FQ1-FQ3 only, so FQ4 is the 10-K annual minus the nine-month year-to-date: 115,948 - 80,146 = 35,802 for April to June 2026 (10-K acc 0001193125-26-323660).

Its own capex metric adds finance-lease additions (RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForFinanceLeaseLiability 24,608,000,000 FY2026); the tagged line and the company metric are never mixed in one series.
Depreciation is tagged as 'Depreciation' (34,300,000,000 FY2026), not DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization; the depreciationAmortization ladder must carry it.
Maturity buckets are fiscal-year buckets ('Year Ending June 30').

hyperscalers.name: Alphabet Inc.
notes: Calendar year. Cash-flow facts are year-to-date after Q1, so Q2-Q4 are de-cumulated (H1 2026 capex 80,598,000,000; Q2 44,924 by differencing).
The CIK carries four tickers (GOOGL, GOOG, GOOGM, GOOGN); the cohort row is GOOG, the one in coverage.

Debt proceeds are ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCosts (56,226,000,000 H1 2026); dividends PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends (5,231,000,000 H1 2026); JV partner cash ProceedsFromMinorityShareholders (3,758,000,000 H1 2026). Purchase commitments moved from PurchaseObligation (7,700,000,000 at 2025-12-31) to LongTermPurchaseCommitmentAmount, a duration fact (232,700,000,000 to 2026-03-31; 707,000,000,000 to 2026-06-30); its uncommenced leases sit under the unrecorded tag (75,600,000,000 at 2026-03-31), served as unrecordedPurchaseObligations and labeled 'Leases not yet commenced'.
InterestExpense has no fact ending 2024 or later; InterestExpenseNonoperating is the live tag (1,278,000,000 Q2 2026).

hyperscalers.name: AMAZON COM INC
notes: Calendar year. Tags three spans per cash-flow line (quarter, year-to-date, trailing twelve months), so facts are selected by (start, end), never by longest span: the TTM row (capex 173,028,000,000 to 2026-06-30) is the run-rate check value and must never land as a quarter or a year.

Capex is PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets (54,208,000,000 Q2 2026); its own free-cash-flow metric nets proceeds and incentives, so the gross tagged line and the company figure are shown side by side.
InterestExpense has no fact ending 2024 or later.
Q2 2026 10-Q acc 0001018724-26-000026 (filed 2026-07-31): the regression fixture for the duration fix (operating cash flow 45,387,000,000, period end 2026-06-30).

DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount is its NON-CURRENT carrying amount (128,894,000,000 at 2026-06-30, LongTermDebtNoncurrent to the dollar); the totalDebtPrincipal screen drops it and the ladder falls through to LongTermDebt, the face value (132,995,000,000).

hyperscalers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
notes: Calendar year. Cash-flow facts are year-to-date after Q1 (H1 2026 capex 49,113,000,000; Q1 18,997, so Q2 30,116).
Lease schedules and the finance-lease liability are tagged only in the 10-K (RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForFinanceLeaseLiability 613,000,000 FY2025, annual only).

UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationBalanceSheetAmount 278,990,000,000 is its leases-not-yet-commenced figure, served under unrecordedPurchaseObligations (not purchaseObligations, which carries its 349,310,000,000 commitment table) and labeled 'Leases not yet commenced' through LABEL_OVERRIDES.

Its own capex metric adds finance leases (FY2025 company metric 72.22B against the tagged 69,691,000,000); the Louisiana and El Paso ventures are equity-method, so no partner cash appears in its statements.

hyperscalers.name: ORACLE CORP
notes: May 31 fiscal year: quarters end Aug 31, Nov 30, Feb 28/29 and May 31, one month before the calendar quarter; 2026-05-31 sits in the calendar-Q2 2026 column labeled 'FQ4 FY26, Mar-May', with the footnote on every aggregate. companyfacts fy=2026 fp=FY is the year to 2026-05-31.
Three-month cash-flow facts exist for Q1 only; Q2-Q4 are de-cumulated (FY2026 capex 55,663,000,000; FQ4 16,493 = 55,663 - 39,170).
companyfacts carries one placeholder row dated 2199-12-31; the feed filter caps period ends at today.

DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount leaks dimensioned issue sizes at 10-Q dates (18,000,000,000 at 2025-11-30; 43,000,000,000 at 2026-02-28) against 130,105,000,000 at 2026-05-31. The totalDebtPrincipal screen in scripts/lib/statements.mjs drops a row below half the debt on the balance sheet at the same date (99,984 + 8,091 and 124,718 + 9,887 million), so those two quarters serve null and a card shows 'last tagged 2026-05-31'; the balance-sheet lines (longTermDebt, shortTermDebt) carry the carrying total at every quarter.

The custom line 'Proceeds from short-term financing related to capital expenditures, net' is absent from companyfacts and is hand-keyed in cash-flow sign (FY2026 +3,345; FY2025 +1,422; Q1 FY27 -830). No InterestCostsCapitalized or MarketableSecuritiesCurrent tag.
Q1 FY2027 10-Q (quarter to 2026-08-31) was filed 2026-09-11, acc 0001193125-26-389274, the day this file was keyed; companyfacts may lag it by weeks.

Its 10-Q for the quarter to 2026-08-31 carries fy=2026 fp=Q1, the slot of the quarter to 2025-08-31; the overview shows the latest period end (Aug 31, 2026) and the statements label the later quarter Q1 FY2027.

neoclouds.name: CoreWeave, Inc.
neoclouds.label: AI infrastructure
notes: Calendar year; 10-K/10-Q/8-K filer (former Atlantic Crypto Corp to 2019-10-03). Latest 10-Q Q2 2026 acc 0001769628-26-000366 (filed 2026-08-12).
LongTermDebt is not re-tagged at Q2 2026 (last 2026-03-31, 24,859,000,000); the card shows 'last tagged 2026-03-31' and gross debt reads DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount 35,551,000,000 at 2026-06-30.

Convertible notes sit inside the generic ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebt tag (16,747,000,000 H1 2026) and are split from the deal ledger, labeled 'ledger split'; no ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt tag.
All notes are Rule 144A, so issuance events surface only in 8-K Items 1.01 and 2.03, never as 424B prospectuses.
Its own capex metric is the change in gross PP&E including construction in progress (FY2025 company figure 14.9B against the tagged 10,309,000,000).

Equity: the 10-K files the IPO (1,491,000,000 for 2025) under ProceedsFromIssuanceInitialPublicOffering (ipoProceeds) and 0 under ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock, after the 10-Qs carried 67,669,000 of common-stock proceeds for the nine months, so the derived fourth quarter of equityIssued is not served (notDerivable); the private placements are ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePlacement (2,982,000,000 H1 2026, equityIssued).

neoclouds.name: Nebius Group N.V.
neoclouds.label: AI infrastructure
notes: Foreign private issuer (Netherlands N.V., formerly Yandex N.V. to 2024-08-16): 20-F annual, 6-K interim. fiscalYearEnd is null in the submissions feed; the year is the calendar year (20-F for the year to December 31). CIK 1073429, which one working note gave for Nebius, is U.S. Concrete, Inc.

Every 6-K carries isXBRL=0, so companyfacts holds annual USD facts only (FY2024, FY2025). Quarters come from the interim-report 6-K exhibits through scripts/lib/interim-parse.mjs, hand-keyed and proven in frontend/data/nbis-interims.json and scripts/test-nbis-interims.mjs. Interim reports with statements began with Q1 2026 (acc 0001104659-26-064092, filed 2026-05-20); Q2 2026 is acc 0001104659-26-094844 (filed 2026-08-12).

Two 6-Ks were filed on 2026-08-12: 0001104659-26-094568 (press release EX-99.1, shareholder letter EX-99.2) and 0001104659-26-094844 (OFR EX-99.1, financial statements EX-99.2). Cite the accession, never 'EX-99.2' alone.

companyfacts carries RUB-unit Yandex-era facts under the same concepts to 2023-12-31 and USD facts for the Yandex years from 2011; every pull filters unit = USD. historyStart 2024-01-01: the panel builder drops every fact ending before 2024, so the panel row starts at 2024 (the Yandex years never reach the panel or the AI-infrastructure aggregate). The statements route serves the whole document.

The annual anchor for the 6-K quarters is PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment 4,066,000,000 FY2025 (20-F acc 0001104659-26-052948); the 20-F/A of 2026-05-22 did not replace the tagged financials as of 2026-09-11.

Customer prepayments are recognised in operating cash flow (deferred revenue rose 4,395.0M in H1 2026), which lowers its capex-to-operating-cash-flow ratio; the popup says so. The March 2026 converts accrete: principal at maturity 3,105.0 and 2,100.0 at 2026-06-30 against $4.34B original.

neoclouds.name: Applied Digital Corp.
neoclouds.label: AI infrastructure
notes: May 31 fiscal year, like Oracle: quarters end Aug 31, Nov 30, Feb 28/29 and May 31, one month before the calendar quarter, with the same footnote. Latest 10-K FY2026 acc 0001144879-26-000048 (filed 2026-07-29).
Capex is PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets (2,865,765,000 FY2026); PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment was last tagged 2023-08-31.

Debt raised is ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMediumTermNotes (4,955,327,000 FY2026) and repaid RepaymentsOfMediumTermNotes (521,512,000); preferred ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredStockAndPreferenceStock 814,998,000 (never the rounded 815,000,000); Macquarie's units are ProceedsFromMinorityShareholders 1,825,000,000 and RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCarryingAmount 1,956,303,000.
RestrictedCashCurrent 2,381,027,000 at 2026-05-31 is escrowed 2031-note proceeds, released 2026-06-18; the revolver was upsized to $430M on 2026-06-26 (events after the balance-sheet date).
Backlog is LessorOperatingLeasePaymentsToBeReceived 35,844,882,000 with buckets, because its contracts are leases.

neoclouds.name: IREN Ltd
neoclouds.label: AI infrastructure
notes: June 30 fiscal year, like Microsoft; quarters align with the calendar grid. A 10-K filer only since fiscal 2025 (first 10-K filed 2025-08-28), IFRS 20-F before; its us-gaap history under the same CIK starts at fiscal 2022. Still an Australian company (state of incorporation C3), so it files 8-Ks and historically 6-Ks. Former names Iris Energy Ltd (to 2024-11-29) and Iris Energy Pty Ltd.

PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment (2,998,006,000 FY2026) excludes its second capex line 'Payments for computer hardware' (1,335,081,000 FY2026), which carries no us-gaap tag. The hardware line is hand-keyed per span with its accession in frontend/data/capex-adjustments.json (from the capex-ledger refutation), and the series a reader builds is the sum, 4,333.1M, never 2,998.0.

Debt raised is ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt (6,299,555,000 FY2026); the DDTL ($413M of $1,545M) and USPP ($525M of $2,100M) draws are text only, with 'Proceeds from financing facilities 938,000' on the face of the statement.
EDGAR SIC 6199 'Finance Services' (the bitcoin-mining legacy); decision 12.18 overrides it to 'AI infrastructure'.
Latest 10-K FY2026 acc 0001878848-26-000052 (filed 2026-08-27); DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount 7,705,649,000 at 2026-06-30.

neoclouds.name: Cipher Digital Inc.
neoclouds.label: AI infrastructure
notes: Calendar year. EDGAR name is 'Cipher Digital Inc.'; 'Cipher Mining Inc.' to 2026-02-23 (and GOOD WORKS ACQUISITION CORP. before 2021-08-25), so the cohort row carries the index name and the override is keyed by CIK.

Capex is on the combined basis it adopted in 2026, purchases of property and equipment plus deposits on equipment: 2024 302.5M (139,495 + 162,958) and 2025 492.8M (487,921 + 4,874) from the FY2025 10-K (acc 0001819989-26-000009, R8), never 139.5 and 487.9. The deposits line is hand-keyed per span with its accession in frontend/data/capex-adjustments.json for the spans the tagged line still carries on the purchases-only basis; the Q1 and H1 2025 comparatives were recast to the combined basis in the 2026 10-Qs (99,675,000 and 218,245,000) and need no adjustment, and the Q2 2026 10-Q (acc 0001819989-26-000041) prints a single 'Purchases of property and equipment' line (964,261 thousand H1).

The project notes sit in SPV issuers (Cipher Compute LLC, Black Pearl Compute LLC, Stingray Compute LLC); the maturity ladder from companyfacts lacks about 3.6B of 2030-31 principal, hand-keyed from the note.
EDGAR SIC 6199 'Finance Services'; decision 12.18 overrides it to 'AI infrastructure'.

neoclouds.name: TERAWULF INC.
neoclouds.label: AI infrastructure
notes: Calendar year. The CIK is the former IKONICS Corp shell (reverse merger December 2021), so companyfacts carries IKONICS facts (a photo-imaging company, 2010-2021) under it. historyStart 2022-01-01: the panel builder drops every fact ending before 2022, so the panel row and its AI-infrastructure aggregate start at 2022. LongTermDebtNoncurrent is not re-tagged at Q2 2026 (last 2026-03-31, 3,060,194,000); the card shows 'last tagged 2026-03-31'. ConvertibleDebt 1,101,976,000 at 2026-06-30.

Issuance tags change by period: ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredDebt in 2025 (no fact ending 2026-06-30), ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock 1,199,820,000 in H1 2026; resolve per period, not first-tag-wins.
EDGAR SIC 6199 'Finance Services'; decision 12.18 overrides it to 'AI infrastructure'. Latest 10-Q Q2 2026 acc 0001083301-26-000166 (filed 2026-08-05).

landlords.name: EQUINIX INC
notes: Calendar year; REIT; already in weekly coverage before PR H1.

Capex tag changed at Q2 2026: PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets to 2026-03-31 (1,256,000,000 Q1 2026), PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPlantAndEquipment from Q2 2026 (2,834,000,000 H1 2026); the ladder carries both.

Repayments split across RepaymentsOfSeniorDebt (700,000,000, debtRepaid) and RepaymentsOfOtherDebt (682,000,000, its own key otherDebtRepaid) in H1 2026, so a reader adds the two keys for Equinix: 674,000,000 + 0 in the first quarter and 8,000,000 + 700,000,000 in the second. InterestExpense is stale (last 2024-03-31), InterestExpenseNonoperating is live (151,000,000 Q2 2026).
Behind the cohort toggle, off by default (decision 12.16).

landlords.name: DIGITAL REALTY TRUST, INC.

Its Q2 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-07-31, acc 0001104659-26-089296, inline XBRL) is not in companyfacts as of 2026-09-11, so its series ends 2026-03-31 and the page states the known limit.

Capex is PaymentsToDevelopRealEstateAssets (870,038,000 Q1 2026); interest is InterestExpense.
